page.heading: Companies
page.description: Tenants on this installation. Each has its own users, projects and deals.

empty.title: No companies yet
empty.description: Create one to onboard a developer onto this installation.

created.title: {{name}} is ready
created.generatedPasswordLabel: Generated password — shown once, and not recoverable afterwards:
created.generatedPasswordHint: Give it to them directly and have them change it at first login.

suspend.title: Suspend this company?
suspend.body: Everyone in this tenant is signed out and cannot log in until it is resumed. Their data is untouched.

resume.title: Resume this company?
resume.body: Its users will be able to log in again immediately.

delete.title: Delete this company?
delete.body: It disappears from this list and its users can no longer log in. Their projects, deals and payment history are kept, but there is no way to undo this from the interface.

form.editDescription: Company settings. Currency and locale drive how money and dates appear for everyone in this tenant.
form.newDescription: The first administrator is created with the company — a tenant with no way in cannot create one for itself.
form.adminPasswordHint: Leave blank to generate one. It is shown once.

detail.suspendedBanner: Suspended on {{date}}. Nobody in this tenant can log in until it is resumed. Their data is untouched.

usersCard.title: Users
usersCard.empty: No users. This tenant cannot be logged into.

deactivate.title: Deactivate this user?
deactivate.body: They are signed out immediately and cannot log in until reactivated.

reactivate.title: Reactivate this user?
reactivate.body: They will be able to log in again immediately.

resetPassword.title: Reset this user's password?
resetPassword.body: A new password is generated and shown once. Their existing sessions are signed out.

impersonate.title: View the app as this user?
impersonate.body: You will see exactly what they see, for a limited time. Actions you take are performed as them, and are logged against your account.

resetResult.title: Password reset
resetResult.passwordLabel: Generated password — shown once, and not recoverable afterwards:
resetResult.passwordHint: Give it to them directly and have them change it at first login.
